          FAQs

          Hot deal and last-minute flight ticket FAQs

          Find helpful information about Saudia flight booking offers, last-minute fares, discounted tickets, eligible destinations and important considerations before completing your booking.

          What are Saudia’s hot deals on flight tickets?

          Saudia hot deals offer travelers the opportunity to discover attractive fares to selected destinations across the airline’s network, making it easier to plan a memorable journey at great value.

          Which destinations can I get discounted flight tickets on with Saudia’s hot deals?

          Hot deals may be available across a variety of destinations in Saudi Arabia and around the world, including popular cities throughout Europe, Asia, Africa, and North America.

          How can I find the cheapest last-minute flight tickets?

          Explore available destinations and compare travel dates to find a fare that works for your plans. Being flexible with your departure or return dates can also help you discover more travel options.

          How long are the discounted flight tickets available for?

          Special fares may be available for a limited time and can vary depending on destination, travel dates, and availability. Travelers are encouraged to review the fare details when booking.

          Can I book last-minute tickets and discount fares online?

          Yes, travelers can explore available fares, select their preferred itinerary, and continue through the online booking process to plan their journey with Saudia.

          What should I check before booking flight tickets on offer?

          Before booking, review your travel dates, destination, fare conditions, baggage information, and any applicable travel requirements to ensure the selected journey matches your plans.
